summary: Run `./setup.sh -s` from the installer folder to install `sos` on every inventory node and generate sos reports (as a non-root sudo user prefix `ANSIBLE_BECOME_METHOD='sudo' ANSIBLE_BECOME=True`). Reports land in `/tmp` unless you set `target_sos_directory`; add `case_number`, `clean=true` and `upload=true` to sanitize and upload to Red Hat.
questions: How do I generate an sos report for AAP?
How do I upload AAP sos reports to a support case?
Where are AAP sos reports saved?

answer_card.title: Collect sos reports (RPM)
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
./setup.sh -s
./setup.sh -e 'target_sos_directory=/path/to/files' -s
./setup.sh -e 'case_number=0000000' -e 'clean=true' -e 'upload=true' -s
```
`clean` obfuscates sensitive data; `upload` sends it to Red Hat. Default location is `/tmp`.
